contract.title: AquaInSAR provisional data contract for exploratory satellite-to-ground comparison
governing_principles: ADR-0001: report deformation as an observation before any groundwater interpretation
Evidence levels: Planned < Observed < Associated < Validated < Predicted
No assumption is converted into a confirmed project requirement

in_scope: required metadata and field specifications for prospective InSAR displacement, groundwater well, and rainfall tables
validation rules and reporting behaviour for those tables
explicit placeholders for pilot-dependent spatial and temporal decisions
out_of_scope: unit conversion, reprojection, interpolation or spatial joins
validation, risk classification, forecasting and alerting

contract.why_not_v1_0: AQ-01 (pilot), AQ-03 (reference data), AQ-04 (Sentinel-1 evidence) and AQ-05 (CRS, grid, units, formats, vocabularies) are unresolved and no real dataset exists in the repository. A v1.0 claim would imply a coherent initial specification that the evidence does not support.

missing_values.rule: An empty field is the only accepted null representation. Values such as -9999 are measurements unless explicitly declared otherwise in a dataset version; no silent recoding is permitted.

timestamps.date_only_timezone_policy: Do not invent a timezone for date-only source records; retain source value and flag precision.
timestamps.acquisition_vs_observation: SAR acquisition_date and well observation_date are distinct concepts and must not share a column unless a documented equivalence rule exists.

coordinates.crs_policy: Every geometry or coordinate column must declare its CRS explicitly. No CRS is inferred from coordinate values.
coordinates.w1_geometry_scope: Point coordinates and identifiers only. Polygon boundaries, rasters and common grids are deferred until a pilot is selected.
coordinates.invalid_geometry_policy: Report invalid coordinates in a validation report. Never drop, clamp or silently repair them.

units.policy: Every measurement value is accompanied by an explicit unit field. No implicit units and no automatic conversion.
units.conversion_rule: Conversion may be added only in a later contract version with a recorded formula, source unit, target unit and lineage.

provenance.lineage_rule: Derived records must preserve input dataset id/version, code version, processing date, parameters and operator.

quality.policy: Quality flags and uncertainty fields travel with measurements. If uncertainty is not quantified, the value is empty and the reason is UNKNOWN or NOT_MEASURED; absence must not be read as certainty.

validation_rules.name: required_columns
validation_rules.description: All required fields in the active dataset schema must be present as columns.

validation_rules.name: unexpected_columns
validation_rules.description: Columns not defined in the active schema are reported, not ignored silently.

validation_rules.name: non_nullable_empty
validation_rules.description: Non-nullable fields must contain a non-empty value in every row.

validation_rules.name: type_parse
validation_rules.description: Values must parse as the declared type (decimal, integer, date, datetime); non-finite numbers are rejected.

validation_rules.name: coordinate_range
validation_rules.description: longitude and latitude must be finite and within the declared global ranges; CRS must still be declared separately.

validation_rules.name: allowed_values
validation_rules.description: Categorical fields must use one of their declared allowed_values.

validation_rules.name: pattern
validation_rules.description: String fields with a declared pattern must fully match it.

validation_rules.name: duplicate_key
validation_rules.description: Every declared unique constraint must hold across all rows.

validation_rules.name: unit_pair_presence
validation_rules.description: If a measurement value is present, its paired unit field must be present.

validation_rules.name: provenance_completeness
validation_rules.description: Dataset metadata and record provenance fields required by the contract must be present and non-empty.

validation_rules.name: contract_internal_consistency
validation_rules.description: The machine-readable contract must have unique dataset ids, unique field names per dataset, valid field definitions and resolvable unique-constraint fields.

datasets.name: Sentinel-1 derived displacement time series (prospective)
datasets.description: Point/pixel displacement observations derived from Sentinel-1 interferometric processing. This is a derived measurement, not raw SLC imagery and not a groundwater measurement.
datasets.source_organisation: European Space Agency Copernicus Sentinel-1; processing route not selected
datasets.acquisition_or_publication_method: SAR acquisition followed by an interferometric time-series workflow; exact processor and configuration undecided
datasets.spatial_coverage: PENDING: bounded by AQ-01 pilot decision
datasets.temporal_coverage: PENDING: bounded by scene availability (AQ-04) and study period
datasets.spatial_resolution: PENDING: depends on product and processing; not asserted
datasets.temporal_resolution: PENDING: Sentinel-1 revisit is source-dependent and not verified for the pilot

crs.requirement: Must be recorded per dataset before real data are processed

datasets.data_format: CSV (tabular point/pixel series); raster products deferred
known_limitations: Line-of-sight displacement is not automatically vertical subsidence
Atmospheric artefacts, orbit errors, decorrelation and unwrapping errors are possible
Agricultural coherence is unverified for any candidate
No scene manifest or processed product exists in the repository

fields.name: observation_id
fields.description: Stable unique identifier for one displacement observation record.

fields.name: dataset_id
fields.description: Identifier of the source/derived dataset version.

fields.name: pixel_id
fields.description: Stable pixel or persistent-scatterer identifier within the processing frame.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: X coordinate in the declared CRS; longitude when CRS is geographic.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Y coordinate in the declared CRS; latitude when CRS is geographic.

fields.name: crs
fields.description: Explicit CRS identifier (EPSG code or WKT). Required even though the canonical value is pending.

fields.name: acquisition_date
fields.description: SAR acquisition date for this observation; distinct from well observation_date.

fields.name: reference_date
fields.description: Date to which the displacement is referenced, if the product is a time series relative to a reference.

fields.name: measurement_convention
fields.description: Whether displacement is line-of-sight, vertical or unknown.

fields.name: deformation_value
fields.description: Displacement value; sign convention must be documented in processing_lineage.

fields.name: deformation_unit
fields.description: Unit of deformation_value; no implicit conversion is performed.

fields.name: coherence
fields.description: Interferometric coherence where supplied.

fields.name: quality_flag
fields.description: Processing quality state of this observation.

fields.name: uncertainty_value
fields.description: Uncertainty estimate when quantified; empty otherwise.

fields.name: uncertainty_method
fields.description: Method used for uncertainty_value, or NOT_QUANTIFIED where applicable.

fields.name: missing_reason
fields.description: Reason code for any empty optional field.

fields.name: source_reference
fields.description: Link or citation identifying the exact source version.

fields.name: processing_lineage
fields.description: Inputs, code/config version, parameters, date and operator for this derived value.

datasets.name: Groundwater observation-well records (prospective)
datasets.description: Station-level groundwater level or piezometric head observations from CGWB/state records. Not an InSAR measurement and not a validation label by itself.
datasets.source_organisation: Central Ground Water Board / Uttar Pradesh Ground Water Department
datasets.acquisition_or_publication_method: Monitoring-well measurement; source states four seasonal readings per year in UP year books
datasets.spatial_coverage: PENDING: selected assessment units / well coordinates after AQ-01 and AQ-03
datasets.temporal_coverage: PENDING: source examples 2023-24; no local series in repository
datasets.temporal_resolution: PENDING: source-reported four seasonal readings per year; not confirmed for pilot

crs.requirement: Year book coordinates are decimal degrees but CRS is not stated; must be confirmed

datasets.data_format: CSV extracted from published PDF tables; original PDFs retained as source
known_limitations: Four samples per year cannot by itself establish a long-term trend
Datum, screen depth, aquifer tapped and missing reasons are not yet compiled
Well coordinates and CRS are not validated
Extraction-stage categories are not water-level measurements

datasets.name: Rainfall records (prospective)
datasets.description: District-level or station rainfall used as environmental context. Spatial support must be recorded because district aggregates may not match a pilot boundary or well location.
datasets.source_organisation: India Meteorological Department / IMD-derived tables in CGWB year books
datasets.acquisition_or_publication_method: Public statistics pages and year-book tables; exact files not selected
datasets.spatial_coverage: PENDING: district aggregates or station locations relative to pilot boundary
datasets.temporal_coverage: PENDING: multi-year IMD archives; exact period depends on product
datasets.spatial_resolution: PENDING: station or district aggregate; gridded product unconfirmed
datasets.temporal_resolution: PENDING: monthly/seasonal/annual aggregation to be confirmed

crs.requirement: Must be declared before spatial matching

known_limitations: District aggregates may not match pilot boundary or well locations
One year of values cannot establish seasonal climatology
Station versus gridded provenance is unresolved
